strings.gate.title: 全球最大的绿洲，在您眼前一章章展开
strings.gate.lead: 沙下藏水，山中洞穴密布，集市世代相传。向下滑动，开启这段故事。
strings.rail.label: 页面章节
strings.water.title: 沙下之水
strings.water.lead: 一片巨大的地下含水层滋养着绿洲，让它在大漠腹地保持葱绿。
strings.water.springsL: 处自流泉，灌溉着这片绿洲

strings.qarah.title: 卡拉山：亲手拨转一天的时光
strings.qarah.drag: 拖动滑块，从黎明到日落。
strings.map.title: 选一处让您心动的地方
strings.map.lead: 每个景点都标在真实位置上。点击即可查看，还能把它收进“我的收藏”。
strings.map.empty: 在地图上选一处景点，即可查看它的照片与介绍。
strings.memory.title: 泥土与集市的记忆
strings.memory.lead: 泥筑的城堡、伊斯兰教早期兴建的清真寺，还有世代相传的传统市集。
strings.memory.track: 历史古迹列表，可左右滑动
strings.plan.title: 行程规划，只需三个问题
strings.plan.lead: 答完问题，路线随即出现，您在地图上收藏的景点也会一并排入。
strings.plan.wait: 回答这三个问题，您的路线将显示在这里。
strings.tpl.heritage-1.title: 一天，穿行于胡富夫的城堡与东部最古老的清真寺之间
strings.tpl.heritage-2.title: 两天：先走老城，再访哈萨东部村落
strings.tpl.heritage-3.title: 三天，终点是沙特阿拉伯东部沿海的第一座海港
strings.tpl.nature-1.title: 一天，穿行于卡拉山的洞穴与绿洲果园之间
strings.tpl.nature-2.title: 两天：先访山与果园，再赴沙丘间的湖泊
strings.tpl.nature-3.title: 三天，终点在海湾之滨
strings.tpl.markets-1.title: 一天，漫步胡富夫的传统市集
strings.tpl.markets-2.title: 两天：先逛市集，再到卡拉山寻访陶器
strings.tpl.markets-3.title: 三天，终点在绿洲果园
strings.tip.family: 为当天行程就近添一处家庭公园：贾瓦塔清真寺旁边的贾瓦塔公园；适合散步和出游的阿卜杜拉国王环境公园；去海岸的那天，还有乌盖尔海滩。
strings.tip.friends: 如果您喜欢沙漠出游：阿斯法湖与国家公园路线需要四驱车；阿尔巴山位于胡富夫东南，是露营与沙漠出游的目的地。
strings.tip.solo: 胡富夫历史路线全程步行，在城堡与市集之间度过安静的一天；若想了解更多，哈萨博物馆呈现了这一地区的历史与文物。
strings.finale.title: 绿洲静候您的到来
strings.finale.lead: 从阿斯法湖畔的黄沙，到椰枣林的绿荫，您的旅程由此开始。
strings.saved.build: 用收藏的景点规划行程

Not 地下水库 (reads as an engineered reservoir). Judge (zh-home-1): approved unchanged.

[s1] tip.friends: 'Al-Asfar Lake trail' rendered with the published trail title 阿斯法湖与国家公园路线 (the 4x4 note belongs to that trail). tip.family uses 贾瓦塔公园 + 旁边 (termbase Jawatha Park note), 阿卜杜拉国王环境公园, 乌盖尔海滩 (title_zh). No Latin glosses on the home page (UI copy, as in the old home).
[s1] Generic descriptions kept generic: 胡富夫的古堡, 东部最古老的清真寺, 哈萨东部村落 (termbase eastern villages), 绿洲果园 (groves; 果园 as in home.hero.title).
[s1] Sources line composes to: 资料来源：吉尼斯世界纪录“最大的绿洲”（椰枣树与泉眼）；沙特环境水务与农业部统计数据（椰枣树）；联合国教科文组织《世界遗产名录》（2018 年）。
[s1] map.lead: 'save it for your trip' → 收进“我的收藏” per ctx; finale.plan = 行程规划 (published page name).
[s1] water.srcEnd = （2018 年）。 — 年 added (Chinese year form; verify requires a CJK char in every string).

[s2] CROSS ح1 applied: memory.date.jalaniyah = 伊斯兰历 5 世纪 (verbatim from jalaniyah body_zh 约在伊斯兰历 5 世纪（公元 11 世纪前后）; the CE gloss is dropped — 11 is outside both sources and a badge stays short); memory.date.qaisariyah = 200 多年历史 (qaisariyah faq a_zh 已有 200 多年历史, cut to a badge); plan.day1..3 = 第 1 天 / 第 2 天 / 第 3 天 (old home home.route.d1.k). water.srcEnd = （2018）。 — 年 dropped as an addition to the source; sources line now composes to 资料来源：吉尼斯世界纪录“最大的绿洲”（椰枣树与泉眼）；沙特环境水务与农业部统计数据（椰枣树）；联合国教科文组织《世界遗产名录》（2018）。

[s2] CROSS ح2 applied: times = 黎明 · 上午 · 下午 · 日落. 上午/下午 chosen as one matched pair (same length, same 午 axis), so the four ticks stay parallel. 下午 rather than 午后: 午后 leans to the hours just after noon, while al-Asil is the late part of the day; on a dawn→sunset slider 下午 sits between 上午 and 日落 and cannot be confused with 日落, which 傍晚 could.

[s2] CROSS ح3: kept the full published 阿斯法湖与国家公园路线 in tip.friends — the clause is short (…路线需要四驱车) and the full title rules out any other trail; it is also the trail whose published intro carries the 4x4 note.

[s2] water.springsL classifier 眼 → 处: the brief asks the label to open with 处… like the sibling card (处景点，等您逐一探索) and the published fact.springs.l (处泉眼与水渠); card reads 280 多处自流泉，灌溉着这片绿洲 (تروي = irrigate → 灌溉).

[s2] Category links aligned with published ui.ts category names: water.link 探索自然风光 (cat.nature.t 自然风光); memory.link / memory.track 历史古迹 (cat.historic.t, foot.l.historic). map.more 景点页面 = TM ui.trails.landmark.

[s2] Rhythm edits (no fact change): gate.lead 沙下藏水，山间洞穴密布，集市世代相传; water.lead 葱茏常绿; qarah.title 亲手拨转一天的时光 (时光 replaces 光影, which added a light motif absent from the source); qarah.drag 拖动滑块，从黎明到日落 (reads on after the published summary); map.title 选一处让您心动的地方 (召唤 is stiff in Chinese; 心动 carries 'calls you' without a quality claim); finale.title 绿洲静候您的到来.
[s2] rail.ch-gate 门户 → 入口: 门户 reads as 'web portal' to a mainland reader; 入口 is the gate of the page without adding an image.

[s2] memory.lead: 伊斯兰教早期兴建的清真寺 keeps 'some of Islam's earliest' (early-Islamic, not 'the oldest'); gate.lead and memory.lead now share 世代相传 for the repeated source phrase 'passed down through generations'.

[s2] tip.family: list separated by ；（each item carries its own descriptor）, and 'add to your day' rendered 为当天行程添一处; tip.friends opens 写给爱好沙漠出游的朋友 (dropped stage 1's 请留意, not in the source); tip.solo restructured so 哈萨博物馆 presents the history (呈现 as in its summary_zh) without the added 可以去.
[s2] Checked for quality words (最好/必去/必打卡/网红/绝美/梦幻): none. 适合 in tip.family is the source's 'for walking and outings' and echoes the park's published summary_zh.
[s3] Brief overrides the localizer prompt: no photo spots, advice, comfort/safety tips or quality claims added; no Latin glosses (home-page UI copy, as in the old home).
[s3] map.lead 轻点 → 点击: the published zh UI uses 点击 for the same action (map.lead.a 点击列表或地图中的任意景点; plan.empty.d 点击“收藏景点”).
[s3] tip.family 海岸那一天，则有 → 去海岸的那天，还有: 那一天 alone left the reader to infer which day; 去海岸的那天 names it as the source does (‘on the coast day’) and reads as natural mainland speech.

[s3] finale.lead 阿斯法的黄沙 → 阿斯法湖畔的黄沙: a mainland reader does not know 阿斯法 as a place on its own; anchoring it to the published title 阿斯法湖 (the chapter image; asfar intro 沙丘间的一片湖) identifies it without adding a fact.

[s3] Considered and left: memory.date.jalaniyah could take the body_zh CE gloss（公元 11 世纪前后）for mainland readers, but 11 is outside both sources (number fence) and the badge must stay short — flagged for the coordinator if a gloss is wanted. 四驱车 (TM ui.trails.mode.4x4), 沙漠出游 (termbase), 伊斯兰历 (style_rules calendar), 鲜活地图, 历史古迹 checked as mainland-natural; religious wording (清真寺, 伊斯兰教早期) respectful and unchanged.

[s4] Benchmark: 自流泉 kept for 'artesian springs' — standard Chinese hydrological term (承压水自流出露); published zh (ui.ts fact.springs.l, Saudipedia zh 哈萨泉水, UNESCO zh 泉眼) only uses the generic 泉眼, which would drop 'artesian' that the English source states. Sources line keeps generic 泉眼 (Guinness record covers springs in general). 地下含水层 kept (standard; no competing published form).

[s4] Fact fence sweep over all strings: removed 葱茏常绿 (water.lead) and the plural 山间 (gate.lead). Checked and kept as source-licensed: 在您眼前 (تتكشّف لك), 心动 (يناديك/calls you, no quality claim), 全程步行 (is walked on foot), 适合散步和出游 (source + published summary_zh), 伊斯兰教早期兴建的清真寺 (من أوائل الإسلام, not 'oldest'), 泥筑的城堡 (clay fortresses). No 最好/必去/必打卡/网红/绝美/梦幻/天然, no photo or comfort advice.
[s4] finale.lead: 湖畔 judged a fair locative (see changed); 从…从 resolved with 由此开始.
[s4] Coordinator ruling applied: memory.date.jalaniyah stays 伊斯兰历 5 世纪 without CE gloss (badge brevity).
[s4] Termbase/published names re-verified against ref.json: 卡拉山, 阿斯法湖与国家公园路线, 胡富夫历史路线, 贾瓦塔公园, 贾瓦塔清真寺, 阿卜杜拉国王环境公园, 乌盖尔海滩, 阿尔巴山, 哈萨博物馆, 我的收藏, 收藏景点, 行程规划, 沙特阿拉伯东部沿海的第一座海港, 前往湖边需要四驱车 — all verbatim.

[s5] Machine sweep over all 87 strings: no half-width prose punctuation, no U+00A0, CJK↔digit spacing present (280 多, 10 公里, 第 1 天, 伊斯兰历 5 世纪, 200 多年), no space between CJK characters, simplified only, misparse sweep (上海/北京/中国/环卫) clean. judge_edits.before: 一天，穿行于胡富夫的古堡与东部最古老的清真寺之间
judge_edits.after: 一天，穿行于胡富夫的城堡与东部最古老的清真寺之间
judge_edits.why: Reader #24 (in part): one source word (fortress / حصن) had 城堡 in memory.lead and tip.solo but 古堡 here; unified on 城堡. Stays a generic description per BRIEF (no swap to 易卜拉欣宫).

judge_edits.before: 在站点附近为当天行程添一处家庭公园：贾瓦塔清真寺旁边的贾瓦塔公园；适合散步和出游的阿卜杜拉国王环境公园；去海岸的那天，还有乌盖尔海滩。
judge_edits.after: 为当天行程就近添一处家庭公园：贾瓦塔清真寺旁边的贾瓦塔公园；适合散步和出游的阿卜杜拉国王环境公园；去海岸的那天，还有乌盖尔海滩。
judge_edits.why: Reader #7: 站点 read as a bus/metro stop; 就近 carries "near your stops" without the transit noun. Coast-day logic (#38) is source/template-level, kept.

judge_edits.before: 写给爱好沙漠出游的朋友：阿斯法湖与国家公园路线需要四驱车；阿尔巴山位于胡富夫东南，是露营与沙漠出游的目的地。
judge_edits.after: 如果您喜欢沙漠出游：阿斯法湖与国家公园路线需要四驱车；阿尔巴山位于胡富夫东南，是露营与沙漠出游的目的地。
judge_edits.why: Reader #8: 写给…的朋友 read like a letter salutation; a conditional opener keeps "for desert-trip lovers" as a tip; published names verbatim.
Reader #13: 重温故事 left unclear whether it scrolls to the top or opens another page; the button returns to chapter 1, so 从头再读 (replay = read again from the start) is clearer with the same meaning.

tm_pairs.en: The world’s largest oasis, unfolding chapter by chapter
tm_pairs.zh: 全球最大的绿洲，在您眼前一章章展开

tm_pairs.en: Water beneath the sand, a mountain of caves, and souqs passed down through generations. Scroll to begin.
tm_pairs.zh: 沙下藏水，山中洞穴密布，集市世代相传。向下滑动，开启这段故事。

tm_pairs.en: A vast underground aquifer feeds the oasis, keeping it green in the heart of the desert.
tm_pairs.zh: 一片巨大的地下含水层滋养着绿洲，让它在大漠腹地保持葱绿。
处自流泉，灌溉着这片绿洲
吉尼斯世界纪录“最大的绿洲”
联合国教科文组织《世界遗产名录》

tm_pairs.en: Jabal Al-Qarah: move the day yourself
tm_pairs.zh: 卡拉山：亲手拨转一天的时光

tm_pairs.en: Drag the slider from dawn to sunset.
tm_pairs.zh: 拖动滑块，从黎明到日落。
选一处让您心动的地方

tm_pairs.en: Landmarks in their true positions. Tap one to see it, and save it for your trip.
tm_pairs.zh: 每个景点都标在真实位置上。点击即可查看，还能把它收进“我的收藏”。

tm_pairs.en: Pick a landmark on the map to see its photo and description.
tm_pairs.zh: 在地图上选一处景点，即可查看它的照片与介绍。

tm_pairs.en: Clay fortresses, some of Islam’s earliest mosques, and souqs passed down through generations.
tm_pairs.zh: 泥筑的城堡、伊斯兰教早期兴建的清真寺，还有世代相传的传统市集。
历史古迹列表，可左右滑动

tm_pairs.en: Plan your trip in three questions
tm_pairs.zh: 行程规划，只需三个问题

tm_pairs.en: Answer, and your route appears at once, with the places you saved from the map.
tm_pairs.zh: 答完问题，路线随即出现，您在地图上收藏的景点也会一并排入。

tm_pairs.en: How many days do you have?
Answer the three questions to see your route here.
tm_pairs.zh: 回答这三个问题，您的路线将显示在这里。

tm_pairs.en: A day between Hofuf’s fortresses and the East’s oldest mosques
tm_pairs.zh: 一天，穿行于胡富夫的城堡与东部最古老的清真寺之间

tm_pairs.en: Two days: the old city, then the eastern villages
tm_pairs.zh: 两天：先走老城，再访哈萨东部村落

tm_pairs.en: Three days ending at Saudi Arabia’s first seaport on its eastern coast
tm_pairs.zh: 三天，终点是沙特阿拉伯东部沿海的第一座海港

tm_pairs.en: A day between Al-Qarah’s caves and the oasis groves
tm_pairs.zh: 一天，穿行于卡拉山的洞穴与绿洲果园之间

tm_pairs.en: Two days: the mountain and groves, then the lake among the dunes
tm_pairs.zh: 两天：先访山与果园，再赴沙丘间的湖泊

tm_pairs.en: Three days ending on the Gulf coast
A day in Hofuf’s heritage souqs
tm_pairs.zh: 一天，漫步胡富夫的传统市集

tm_pairs.en: Two days: the souqs, then pottery at Jabal Al-Qarah
tm_pairs.zh: 两天：先逛市集，再到卡拉山寻访陶器

tm_pairs.en: Three days ending in the oasis groves
Add a family park near your stops: Jawatha Park beside Jawatha Mosque, King Abdullah Environmental Park for walking and outings, and on the coast day, Al-Uqair Beach.
tm_pairs.zh: 为当天行程就近添一处家庭公园：贾瓦塔清真寺旁边的贾瓦塔公园；适合散步和出游的阿卜杜拉国王环境公园；去海岸的那天，还有乌盖尔海滩。

tm_pairs.en: For desert-trip lovers: the Al-Asfar Lake trail needs a 4x4, and Al-Arba Mountain, south-east of Hofuf, is a camping and desert-trip destination.
tm_pairs.zh: 如果您喜欢沙漠出游：阿斯法湖与国家公园路线需要四驱车；阿尔巴山位于胡富夫东南，是露营与沙漠出游的目的地。

tm_pairs.en: The Historic Hofuf Trail is walked on foot, a quiet day between the fortress and the souq; for more, Al-Ahsa Museum presents the region’s history and antiquities.
tm_pairs.zh: 胡富夫历史路线全程步行，在城堡与市集之间度过安静的一天；若想了解更多，哈萨博物馆呈现了这一地区的历史与文物。

tm_pairs.en: From the sands of Al-Asfar to the shade of the palms, your journey starts here.
tm_pairs.zh: 从阿斯法湖畔的黄沙，到椰枣林的绿荫，您的旅程由此开始。
用收藏的景点规划行程

source_defects: Home never locates Al-Ahsa (Eastern Province; nearest airport/city) — reader #30; first mentions of Hofuf, Mubarraz, Al-Arba Mountain and the national park in 阿斯法湖与国家公园路线 have no gloss (#22).
tip.family says "on the coast day" (Al-Uqair Beach) on every route, including 1- and 2-day routes with no coast day — the tip is not route-aware (#38).
Markets templates do not name Al-Qaisariyah although chapter 5 presents it as one of the Gulf oldest souqs (#32).
tpl.markets-2 "pottery at Jabal Al-Qarah" while the Qarah summary never mentions pottery (#33).
tpl.note.asfar / tip.friends: 4x4 required, no alternative (guide/tour) given (#34).
Jalaniyah badge "Fifth century AH" has no CE equivalent; body_zh has 公元 11 世纪前后 — owner may allow a CE gloss on the badge (#15).
"Saudi Arabia first seaport on its eastern coast" (C34) reads as ambiguous (first = oldest? first reached?) in Chinese and in the Arabic «أول ميناء بحري» (#16).
Scope mismatch: template «أقدم مساجد الشرق» vs Jawatha summary "one of the oldest mosques in Islamic history" (#31).
Women souq: whether male visitors may enter is not stated (#20).
No best-season / visa / transport pointer on the home page (#39).

Published zh summaries flagged by the reader (not editable here): Qaisariyah (物产…挑选 subject mismatch; 市集/集市 in one sentence), Ain Najm (name repeated), Jawatha (主麻日聚礼; 继麦地那之后), Ibrahim Palace (宫 title vs 城堡 summary), Al-Uqair summary reused verbatim on map panel and heritage card (#4-#6, #14, #24, #41).
集市/市集 pending owner decision — in this batch: 集市 (gate.lead), 传统市集 (memory.lead, tpl.markets-1), 市集 (plan.int.markets, tpl.markets-2, tip.solo) (#23).
